## Notes

Dennis Gustafsson's new engine uses substepping instead of solver iterations (temporal Gauss-Seidel), a parallel solver for large piles, improved contacts and broad phase; about 5 ms simulation on a 32-thread CPU; credits Erin Catto's Box2D work.
